sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: TRAILING SHORTWAVE IMPULSE ASSOCIATED WITH LARGER SCALE QUE/ONT TROUGH WILL TRACK E ACROSS THE LWR GRT LKS/UPSTATE NY THIS MORNING...AND OFF THE NEW ENGLAND CST THIS EVE...AS RIDGE REMAINS IN PLACE OVER THE CAROLINAS/WRN ATLANTIC. ELSEWHERE...COMPLEX ERN PACIFIC TROUGH WILL EDGE CLOSER TO THE W CST BETWEEN NOW AND MON AS ELONGATED UPR VORT PERSISTS OVER CO/NM. FARTHER SE...WEAK UPR LOW OVER TX SHOULD DRIFT SLOWLY NW THROUGH THE PERIOD. DEEP SE FLOW ON ERN SIDE OF SYSTEM SHOULD CARRY REMNANTS OF T.S. BONNIE NW INTO AR EARLY MON. AT THE SFC...COLD FRONT ASSOCIATED WITH ERN TROUGH SHOULD SETTLE SLOWLY SE ACROSS THE MID ATLANTIC STATES...CNTRL APPALACHIANS... AND LWR OH VLY...AND OZARKS/SRN PLNS...WHILE PREFRONTAL TROUGH MOVES SE ACROSS THE DELMARVA PENINSULA...VA...AND THE WRN/CNTRL CAROLINAS.

sections.title: SRN OH VLY TO MID ATLANTIC CST THIS AFTN/EVE
sections.text: ASCENT ON SRN FRINGE OF LWR LKS SHORTWAVE IMPULSE AND...POSSIBLY ...UPLIFT WITH REMNANT MCV MOVING E FROM IND...SHOULD FOSTER NEW STORM DEVELOPMENT OVER SRN OH/ERN KY AND WV LATER TODAY. THE STORMS SHOULD SUBSEQUENTLY MOVE/DEVELOP E ACROSS THE MOUNTAINS INTO SRN PA/MD/DE/NJ AND NRN VA. MOSTLY CLEAR SKIES AND WLY LOW LVL FLOW ACROSS REGION SHOULD SUPPORT STRONG SFC HEATING...AND THE BOUNDARY LAYER WILL REMAIN FAIRLY MOIST. THESE FACTORS WILL OFFSET WARM MID LVL TEMPERATURES /AROUND MINUS 7C AT 500 MB/ TO YIELD SBCAPE OF 2000-2500 J/KG. BAND OF FASTER WLY ALOFT WITH UPR IMPULSE WILL GRAZE NRN PART OF SLIGHT RISK AREA...WITH 50 KT 500 MB FLOW EXPECTED AS FAR S AS THE MD/PA BORDER. 35-40 KT UNIDIRECTIONAL DEEP SHEAR WILL BE PRESENT OVER THE MID-ATLANTIC REGION...WITH WEAKER SHEAR FARTHER W INTO KY. THIS SETUP SHOULD SUPPORT A FEW SUPERCELLS...LINE SEGMENTS...AND CLUSTERS AS THE STORMS MOVE/DEVELOP ESEWD. ISOLD DMGG WIND GUSTS WILL BE THE MAIN SVR THREAT. A FEW STRONG STORMS ALSO COULD FORM FARTHER S ALONG PREFRONTAL TROUGH IN VA/NC...BUT PROXIMITY OF UPR RIDGE/WEAKER SHEAR SHOULD LIMIT DURATION/EXTENT OF ANY SVR THREAT.

sections.title: SRN PLNS INTO LWR MS VLY THIS AFTN/EVE
sections.text: DAYTIME HEATING OF MOIST WARM SECTOR WILL RESULT IN 1500-2500 J/KG SBCAPE ALONG/AHEAD OF WEAKENING COLD FRONT FROM SRN KS S AND SE INTO NRN AR...OK...AND NRN/ERN TX. POCKETS OF MORE SUBSTANTIAL INSTABILITY /SBCAPE ABOVE 3000 J PER KG/ MAY DEVELOP OVER PARTS OF LA/MS AND AL...ON LEADING EDGE OF RICH LOW LVL MOISTURE SURGE ASSOCIATED WITH REMNANT OF T.S. BONNIE. DIURNALLY ENHANCED STORMS SHOULD ONCE AGAIN FLARE ALONG STALLING FRONT AND/OR ALONG RESIDUAL OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES OVER THE SRN THIRD OF THE PLNS AND PARTS OF THE OZARKS...WITH TX UPR LOW POSSIBLY AIDING DEVELOPMENT IN OK AND TX. FARTHER SE...REMNANT CIRCULATION OF BONNIE MAY ASSIST LOW LVL CONVERGENCE/CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT IN LA/MS AND SRN AR. MARGINALLY SVR HAIL COULD OCCUR WITH THE WEAKLY SHEARED STORMS OVER THE OZARKS AND SRN PLNS. OTHERWISE...A FEW WET MICROBURSTS AND/OR WEAK TORNADOES WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THE STORMS IN THE LWR MS VLY...WHERE DEEPLY MOIST THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT MAY ENHANCE SVR POTENTIAL DESPITE WEAK NATURE OF TROPICAL CIRCULATION /850-700 MB FLOW AOB 25 KTS/.

sections.title: ND EARLY MON
sections.text: SLY LLJ WILL STRENGTHEN OVER THE CNTRL AND NRN HI PLNS AS WLY MID LVL FLOW INCREASES ACROSS THE REGION...WELL S OF A PROGRESSIVE UPR LOW IN AB/SK. WAA...MOISTURE INFLOW...AND ASCENT IN EXIT REGION OF LLJ MAY FOSTER LATE NIGHT TSTM DEVELOPMENT OVER CNTRL ND. THESE STORMS WILL BE ELEVATED...BUT STEEP MID LVL LAPSE RATES AND ASSOCIATED INSTABILITY MAY YIELD A THREAT FOR ISOLD MARGINALLY SVR HAIL. ..CORFIDI/STOPPKOTTE.. 07/25/2010

sections.title: OH VALLEY TO MID ATLANTIC STATES
sections.text: AS S/WV TROUGH AND STRONGER WIND FIELDS TRAVERSE NERN STATES THUNDERSTORMS NOW DEVELOPING ALONG/AHEAD OF THE ATTENDANT COLD FRONT WILL RAPIDLY BECOME A SEVERE WIND THREAT. WITH THE 40-50 KT OF MID LEVEL FLOW COUPLED WITH HIGH PWATS AND MLCAPE AOA 2500 J/KG...THUNDERSTORMS DEVELOPING OVER CENTRAL PA SWWD INTO NRN WV WILL FORM INTO SHORT LINE SEGMENTS/BOWS INCREASING THE WIND DAMAGE POTENTIAL. THE STORMS SHOULD RAPIDLY MOVE ESEWD TO MID ATLANTIC COAST BY THIS EVENING. SWD LIMIT OF THREAT EXPECTED TO BE TO SRN VA THIS EVENING WHICH WILL BE THE SRN EXTENT OF THE STRONGER WESTERLIES. STORMS WILL ALSO DEVELOP ALONG TRAILING FRONTAL ZONE INTO OH VALLEY WHERE SHEAR WILL BE WEAKER BUT AIR MASS WILL UNDERGO STRONG DESTABILIZATION. AGAIN DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE PRIMARY CONCERN WITH MORE PULSE TYPE STORMS.

sections.text: SLY LLJ WILL STRENGTHEN OVER THE CNTRL AND NRN HI PLNS AS WLY MID LVL FLOW INCREASES ACROSS THE REGION...WELL S OF A PROGRESSIVE UPR LOW IN AB/SK. WAA...MOISTURE INFLOW...AND ASCENT IN EXIT REGION OF LLJ MAY FOSTER LATE NIGHT TSTM DEVELOPMENT OVER CNTRL ND. THESE STORMS WILL BE ELEVATED...BUT STEEP MID LVL LAPSE RATES AND ASSOCIATED INSTABILITY MAY YIELD A THREAT FOR ISOLD MARGINALLY SVR HAIL.

sections.title: SRN CASCADES/NRN SIERRA EWD INTO NWRN NV/SERN OR
sections.text: SUFFICIENT MID LEVEL MOISTURE COUPLED WITH THE VERY STEEP LAPSE RATES SUPPORT HIGH BASED THUNDERSTORMS DEVELOPING EWD OFF HIGHER TERRAIN THIS AFTERNOON. WITH BASES OF STORMS NEAR 500 MB...GUSTY WINDS WILL LIKELY BE ASSOCIATED WITH ANY STRONG UPDRAFT GIVEN THE PRONOUNCED EXPECTED EVAPORATION FROM THE HIGH BASED STORMS.

sections.title: CENTRAL GULF COAST STATES
sections.text: REF MCD 1461 REMNANTS OF THE CIRCULATION OF BONNIE HAS MOVED ONSHORE SERN MS. THERE WILL CONTINUE TO BE A LOW PROBABILITY OF BRIEF TORNADOES IN THE ENHANCED BANDS OF CONVECTION THAT WILL BE MOVING INLAND WITH THE CIRCULATION CENTER. ..HALES.. 07/25/2010

sections.title: OH VALLEY TO MID ATLANTIC STATES
sections.text: BROKEN LINE OF STORMS CONTINUES TO MOVE ESE ACROSS LONG ISLAND...NJ...DE...ERN MD...NRN/CNTRL VA...SRN WV AND ERN KY AT 1930Z. ACTIVITY WILL SETTLE SEWD... WITH MOST INTENSE STORMS AFFECTING THE LOWER MD SHORE...SRN DE AND NRN/ERN VA THROUGH LATE AFTERNOON. VERY HOT BOUNDARY LAYER COMBINED WITH LARGELY UNIDIRECTIONAL WLY TROPOSPHERIC FLOW REGIME WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR BOWING LINE SEGMENTS CAPABLE OF INTENSE MICROBURSTS AND HAIL. REMAINDER OF THE FORECAST REMAINS UNCHANGED. ..RACY/HALES/ROGERS.. 07/25/2010 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1122 AM CDT SUN JUL 25 2010/ CORRECTED FOR SPELLING
